name: VMware Blast Extreme
description: VMware Horizon's proprietary VDI display protocol — not a standalone app, but the transport layer that delivers virtual desktops/apps to clients. Dynamically switches between H.264, HEVC, and its own Blast codec, and is the required protocol for Linux VDI desktops. Now part of Omnissa/Broadcom's licensing since the 2023 VMware acquisition.

Wayland Unattended Access.comment: Not clearly documented; the Horizon Linux desktop agent has historically targeted X11

Multi-Monitor Support.comment: Up to 4 monitors, or up to 2 monitors at 1920x1200 (or 1 at 4K) when 3D rendering is enabled

Adaptive Bitrate.comment: Dynamically compensates for latency/bandwidth changes over both TCP and UDP transport

H.265 Codec.comment: HEVC support, including with HDR since Horizon 8 (2106)

Multi-User Sessions.comment: Works with RDSH shared-session desktops in addition to per-user VDI VMs

4:4:4 Chroma Subsampling.comment: Lossy by default, but a "build-to-lossless" mode exists for use cases like medical imaging

Frame Rate (FPS).comment: Frame rate caps are set via Active Directory GPO/Horizon policy, not a fixed number

Session Recording.comment: Not a documented core feature of the protocol itself

ISO Mounting.comment: Client drive redirection maps local drives into the session, but it's not virtual-media/ISO mounting

Pre-Login Access.comment: Users first authenticate to the Horizon Connection Server broker, then reach the VM's actual guest login screen

No Account Required.comment: Requires Horizon/Active Directory credentials to broker the connection

Shared Clipboard.comment: Bidirectional clipboard redirection, though admins can restrict it via policy

2FA / MFA.comment: Supported at the Horizon Connection Server/platform level (RADIUS, SAML, smart card), not a Blast Extreme protocol feature itself

Windows: Host.comment: The primary and best-supported VDI desktop OS

macOS: Host.comment: Only in niche VMware Horizon configurations that virtualize macOS on Apple hardware; not a mainstream desktop pool target

Linux X11: Host.comment: Blast Extreme is specifically required (not optional) for connections to Linux VDI desktops

Web Browser: Client.comment: HTML Access provides a browser-based client using JPG/PNG, or H.264 on Chrome

NVIDIA RTX 4090.comment: Targets datacenter/professional GPU virtualization (NVIDIA vGPU/GRID on Quadro/Tesla-class cards), not consumer GeForce cards

Free Tier.comment: Requires the full paid Horizon/vSphere infrastructure; there's no standalone free version of the protocol

Personal: Monthly.comment: Not sold to individuals; this is enterprise VDI infrastructure

Team / Business: Monthly.comment: Licensed per concurrent user/named user through a reseller, not a self-serve monthly price

Enterprise.comment: Per-CCU or named-user Horizon licensing via reseller; now bundled under Broadcom/Omnissa post-2023 VMware acquisition
